text.ms:
1. (1) Undang-undang kecil ini bolehlah dinamakan Undang-Undang Kecil

Jalan, Parit dan Bangunan (Jenis Khidmat Masyarakat dan Cara Pengawasan

Pelaksanaan Khidmat Masyarakat) (Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan) 2026.

(2) Undang-Undang Kecil ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Julai 2026.

Jenis khidmat masyarakat

2. Jenis khidmat masyarakat yang hendaklah dilaksanakan di bawah suatu perintah

khidmat masyarakat yang dibuat di bawah subseksyen 47(1A) Akta hendaklah

sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Pengawasan oleh pegawai diberi kuasa

3. Pelaksanaan khidmat masyarakat di bawah suatu perintah khidmat masyarakat

yang dibuat di bawah subseksyen 47(1A) Akta hendaklah diawasi oleh pegawai

Perbadanan Labuan yang diberi kuasa secara bertulis bagi maksud itu

oleh Perbadanan Labuan mengikut cara yang berikut:

(a) untuk memberikan taklimat mengenai skop dan tatacara pelaksanaan

suatu khidmat masyarakat;

(b) untuk menunjukkan cara penggunaan yang betul dan selamat bagi

setiap peralatan;

(c) untuk menerangkan tatacara keselamatan sebelum melaksanakan suatu

khidmat masyarakat;

(d) untuk memastikan langkah kawalan keselamatan diambil, termasuk

menyediakan tanda amaran, sarung tangan, pelitup muka dan

jaket keselamatan;

(e) untuk mengawasi pelaksanaan suatu khidmat masyarakat;

(f) untuk merekodkan kehadiran dan pelaksanaan suatu khidmat masyarakat;

dan

(g) untuk menyediakan suatu laporan mengenai pelaksanaan suatu

khidmat masyarakat.

JADUAL

[Undang-Undang Kecil 2]

JENIS KHIDMAT MASYARAKAT

(a) mengutip sampah

(b) menyapu sampah

(c) mencuci

(d) mengemop lantai

(e) mengecat

(f) melupuskan sampah

(g) memotong rumput

(h) mengalihkan bangkai

(i) membersihkan sarang labah-labah

Dibuat 25 Jun 2026

[PL/PUU/100-1/4 Jld. 6 (19); PN(PU2)252/XI]

DATO' MOHD HUSNI BIN MOHAMAD SALLEH

Pengerusi Perbadanan Labuan

STREET, DRAINAGE AND BUILDING ACT 1974

STREET, DRAINAGE AND BUILDING (TYPE OF COMMUNITY SERVICE AND

MANNER OF SUPERVISION OF PERFORMANCE OF COMMUNITY SERVICE)

(FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN) BY-LAWS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 47(1F)(a) and (b) of the

Street, Drainage and Building Act 1974 [Act 133], as extended and modified by

the Federal Territory of Labuan (Extension and Modification of the Street, Drainage and

Building Act 1974) Order 2010 [P.U. (A) 394/2010], the Perbadanan Labuan

makes the following by-laws:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These by-laws may be cited as the Street, Drainage and Building

(Type of Community Service and Manner of Supervision of Performance

of Community Service) (Federal Territory of Labuan) By-Laws 2026.

(2) These By-Laws come into operation on 1 July 2026.

Type of community service

2. The type of community service to be performed under a community service order

made under subsection 47(1A) of the Act shall be as specified in the Schedule.

Supervision by authorized officer

3. The performance of a community service under a community service order made

under subsection 47(1A) of the Act shall be supervised by an officer of

the Perbadanan Labuan authorized in writing in that behalf

by the Perbadanan Labuan in the following manner:

(a) to give briefing on the scope and procedures of the performance of

a community service;

(b) to demonstrate the proper and safe use of every equipment;

(c) to explain the safety procedures before performing a community service;

(d) to ensure the safety control measures are taken, including providing

the warning sign, gloves, face masks and safety jackets;

(e) to monitor the performance of a community service;

(f) to record the attendance and performance of a community service; and

(g) to prepare a report on the performance of a community service.

SCHEDULE

[By-Law 2]

TYPE OF COMMUNITY SERVICE

(a) picking up refuse

(b) sweeping refuse

(c) washing

(d) mopping floors

(e) painting

(f) disposing of refuse

(g) cutting grass

(h) removing carcasses

(i) clearing cobwebs

Made 25 June 2026

[PL/PUU/100-1/4 Jld. 6 (19); PN(PU2)252/XI]

DATO' MOHD HUSNI BIN MOHAMAD SALLEH

Chairman of the Perbadanan Labuan
